text:
You step forward.

The Ember Thread is a frequency — Aldric said so this morning. Not heat exactly, not fire exactly, but the particular resonance of change, of things becoming other things. You reach for it the way you'd reach for something in the dark: carefully, expecting resistance, trying to believe your hand will find what you're looking for.

The thread moves. You feel it, briefly, like a wire pulled tight between your ribs and your palm. The room is very quiet.

choices.text: The thread holds. A steady flame, clean and controlled.
The thread slips. A flash of warmth, then nothing — the flame collapses before it forms.
